param: A Recruitment (birth/immigration) rate into the susceptible population
μ Natural per-capita death rate (applies to all compartments)
u Vaccination rate of susceptible individuals (S→V)
θ Waning rate of vaccine-induced protection (V→S)
β Transmission coefficient (mass-action incidence) driving infection of susceptibles (S→I) via contact with infected
ε Relative susceptibility (or reinfection modifier) for recovered individuals; reinfection term uses εβ
δ Waning rate of natural immunity after recovery (R→S)
